item.title: 🔵 Mandiant details how ShinyHunters abuse SSO to steal cloud data
item.description:
Why this matters: Increased credential/phishing risk for users; reinforce MFA and user awareness.
Mandiant says a wave of recent ShinyHunters SaaS data-theft attacks is being fueled by targeted voice phishing (vishing) attacks and company-branded phishing sites that steal single sign-on (SSO) credentials and multi-factor authentication (MFA) codes. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer   Severity: FYI

item.description:

item.title: 🔵 Microsoft to disable NTLM by default in future Windows releases
item.description:
Why this matters: Could impact sign-ins/MFA/Conditional Access; watch for user login issues.
Microsoft announced that it will disable the 30-year-old NTLM authentication protocol by default in upcoming Windows releases due to security vulnerabilities that expose organizations to cyberattacks. [...]
